text: Materials: bare copper conductor of 120 mm2 for the main ring and grid meshes, 95 mm2 for risers and 50 mm2 for equipment connections, copper-clad or stainless steel rods, exothermic welded or compression joints below ground; no galvanised steel in direct contact with soil or seawater. Bonding to rebar of foundations is permitted where designed together with the cathodic protection (ALP-EPC-00000-EL-CAL-0005); isolating joints shall be provided where the cathodic protection requires them.
